components.name: Gate 1a: SELECT, WHERE, JOINs
components.task: Write 10 SQL queries (3-4 JOIN complexity) from scratch, no hints
components.pass_criteria: 8/10 correct

components.name: Gate 1b: GROUP BY, HAVING, Optimization
components.task: Write 10 optimization queries with EXPLAIN analysis; design Persistent Systems-scale schema
components.pass_criteria: 8/10 correct + EXPLAIN understood

components.name: Gate 1 Final
components.task: Comprehensive SQL assessment: 20 queries cold (mix of all types), optimization understood
components.pass_criteria: 20/20 queries correct OR 18/20 + strong optimization knowledge

components.name: Gate 2a: Arrays & Hashing + Two Pointers + Sliding Window
components.task: Solve 5 problems (one per topic) cold without looking at solutions
components.pass_criteria: Solve 4/5 correctly

components.name: Gate 2b: Stacks & Queues + DSA Consolidation
components.task: Solve all 5 DSA types (Hash Maps, Pointers, Sliding Window, Stack, Queue) cold; verbalize misconception traps
components.pass_criteria: 5/5 problems correct + misconception traps explained for each topic

components.name: Gate 2c: Dynamic Programming (Optional, Lower Priority)
components.task: Solve 6 DP problems cold (Fibonacci, Climbing Stairs, House Robber, Knapsack variants)
components.pass_criteria: 4/6 correct

components.name: Gate 3a: Operating Systems
components.task: Explain from first principles: OS scheduling algorithms, context switching, memory management, synchronization, deadlock
components.pass_criteria: Clear diagrams, no notes, no hints

components.name: Gate 3b: Computer Networks
components.task: Draw and explain TCP 3-way handshake, TCP/IP stack, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, Load Balancing, Congestion Control
components.pass_criteria: Accurate diagrams, clear explanations, Persistent Systems context

components.name: Gate 3c: DBMS
components.task: Explain ACID properties, isolation levels (READ_UNCOMMITTED–SERIALIZABLE), CAP theorem, consistency models, replication strategies, sharding
components.pass_criteria: Trade-offs understood, Persistent Systems examples

components.name: Gate 3 Final
components.task: Comprehensive assessment: 30-min essay + diagrams per domain (OS, Networks, DBMS)
components.pass_criteria: All three domains explained from first principles

components.name: Gate 4a: Caching Strategy
components.task: Design caching strategy for user profile service (10M users, 99.9% hit rate)
components.pass_criteria: TTL tuning, cache stampede prevention, write-through vs write-back justified, Redis Cluster considered

components.name: Gate 4b: Database Sharding
components.task: Design sharding strategy for Persistent Systems-scale user data (100M users, 1000 req/sec)
components.pass_criteria: Consistent hashing explained, geographic sharding, cross-shard transaction strategy, failover

components.name: Gate 4c: Rate Limiter
components.task: Design distributed rate limiter for API gateway (100K req/sec, 100 req/min per user)
components.pass_criteria: Token bucket or leaky bucket algorithm, Redis atomicity (INCR), distributed coordination

components.name: Gate 4d: Microservices + Consensus
components.task: Design microservices architecture with Raft consensus (financial transactions) + eventual consistency (notifications)
components.pass_criteria: Service mesh, inter-service communication (gRPC), saga pattern, when to use consensus vs eventual

components.name: Gate 4 Final: Comprehensive System Design
components.task: Design Persistent Systems-scale system end-to-end: Requirements → Architecture → Data Model → Sharding → Caching → Rate Limiting → Failure Scenarios → Observability
components.pass_criteria: Senku's assessment: Enterprise-ready. Handles 10+ follow-up questions. Trade-offs justified.

components.name: Gate 5a: STAR Stories
components.task: Structure 5 past projects/challenges as STAR stories (Situation, Task, Action, Result), each 2 minutes
components.pass_criteria: All 5 stories clear, no filler, connected to Persistent Systems values (scalability, consistency, resilience)

components.name: Gate 5b: Elevator Pitch
components.task: Deliver 30-second pitch: name, technical strength, why Persistent Systems, value proposition
components.pass_criteria: Pitch lands in 30 sec, no filler, clear Persistent Systems fit, video recorded

components.name: Gate 5c: Referral Activation
components.task: Warm intro from Ranjeet → Mangesh; technical Q&A or first mock
components.pass_criteria: Mangesh feedback: 'Enterprise-ready' OR scheduled for next round

components.name: Gate 5d: HR Mock
components.task: Mock behavioral interview (Rushikesh or written Q&A), 30 minutes
components.pass_criteria: Clear STAR stories, strong Persistent Systems knowledge, no red flags

components.name: Gate 5 Final
components.task: Comprehensive behavioral readiness: Pitch + 3 STAR stories + HR mock feedback integrated
components.pass_criteria: Ready for interviews. Mangesh/Ranjeet green-light.

components.name: Mock v1: First Technical Mock (Ranjeet or Mangesh)
components.task: 1-hour system design interview. Scenario: Design a distributed notification system for 100M users
components.pass_criteria: Senku feedback + Mangesh/Ranjeet feedback collected

components.name: Mock v2: Gap Drills Mock
components.task: Mock v1 gaps addressed. New scenario: Design a financial transaction system (strong consistency required)
components.pass_criteria: Improvements evident. CAP theorem, failure modes, observability clear.

components.name: Mock v3: Final Comprehensive Mock
components.task: Full interview simulation: System Design (1 hour) + Behavioral (30 min) + Technical Q&A (30 min)
components.pass_criteria: Senku assessment: Enterprise-ready. Ready for real Persistent Systems interview.

interview_scheduling.name: Interview Scheduling & Execution
interview_scheduling.goal: Secure offer from Persistent Systems or top-tier alternative by Oct 20

interview_rounds.name: Behavioral Round
interview_rounds.scenario: STAR stories, cultural fit, growth mindset

success_metrics.sql: 10/10 queries correct, can optimize execution plans cold
success_metrics.core_cs: Explain any topic (OS/Networks/DBMS) from first principles
success_metrics.system_design: Design Persistent Systems-scale system, handle 10 follow-up questions
success_metrics.behavioral: Pitch lands, Ranjeet/Mangesh intro succeeds, mock feedback solid
success_metrics.final: Offer in hand from Persistent Systems or top-tier alternative
